title: Neck and Shoulders — 15 Minutes
summary: A short gentle sequence for the posterior neck and upper shoulders.
goal: Combine basic techniques without deep neck pressure.
startingPosition: The head is supported, the neck neutral, and the shoulders relaxed.
direction: From the posterior neck toward the shoulders, then a gentle finish.
warning: This educational routine is not treatment. Do not perform it with contraindications, acute pain, recent injury, inflammation, or worsening wellbeing.
